banner.title: 🥚 How to raise your buddy
banner.body: It grows as you chat and take care of it. At level 12 it gets a job based on how you raised it, and from level 20 it can go its own way.

care.title: 🍚 Care
care.feed: When it is hungry, a baby's bowl is empty and an older one thinks of food. Tap the bowl or the hungry buddy, or send just "food" in the chat.
care.clean: Each tap cleans up one 💩. Send "clean" in the chat to clean them all.
care.pet: Tap your buddy and it cheers, dances or sings.
care.words: Words like "lol", "love you" or "good night" in the chat make the buddy react. It loves it even more when you both pet it.

grow.title: 🌱 Growing
grow.exp: EXP: +1 per message (up to 50 a day), +2 for a meal, +2 per 💩 cleaned, +2 for a grown-up's work (once an hour), +3 for the hot spring after a while (once in 12 hours).
grow.stages: Egg → baby (Lv.3) → kid (Lv.5) → adult (Lv.10). From kid on, it talks.
grow.together: When you both send a message on the same day, you get a together bonus of +{{exp}} EXP once a day. 🤝

job.title: 💼 Jobs
job.decide: At Lv.12 its job is decided by how you raised it. You don't pick it: it depends on what you two did.
job.kinds: Feed it a lot and it becomes a chef, clean up lots of 💩 and a gardener, talk late at night and a radio DJ, say "love you" often and a writer, a bit of everything and a barista.
job.work: With a job, the room gets a work spot. Tap it or send "work" in the chat to work, for +2 EXP once an hour.
job.change: You can change the job in the buddy details once each at level 20, 30, 40 and 50, and any time from 60.

rewards.title: 🎁 Level rewards
rewards.body: Every few levels the room gets a new prop, and the ones it has get finer.

graduate.title: 🎓 Its own way
graduate.top: From level 20 you can let your buddy go its own way from its details. It is your choice, you can keep raising it: up to the top level, 60, the room gets new and better things every level, and EXP keeps counting after it.
graduate.album: It stays as a photo in the memory album on the stage. A new egg comes to the stage.
graduate.keep: It takes its things when it moves out. The new egg’s room starts bare and fills up again.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: puny-chat provides invite-only, one-to-one text and photo chat and a shared Buddy. This policy explains the information we process and your choices.

operator.title: 1. Operator and contact
operator.body: The individual operator of puny-chat manages personal information. Send support and privacy requests to {{email}}.

collection.title: 2. Information processed
collection.body: We process your account identifier (Firebase UID), display name, creation and recent activity times, guest/link status, room membership and invitations. We store message text and photos you send (photos are saved again without metadata such as location), send times, read positions, and Buddy and album state. If you enable notifications, we process device push tokens or web push subscriptions. Google or Apple processes login information such as your email when you link an account; the app may display it to identify your account. Questions and reports include your message, selected reason, related user/room identifiers. Reply emails collected by earlier versions follow the retention period for existing submissions. Reports retain up to 50 recent text messages separately (for photos only the fact that one was sent; the files are deleted with the conversation). Network and hosting operations may process IP addresses, request times and error information.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes
purposes.body: Information is used for authentication and account management, invitations, message delivery and recovery, Buddy state, notifications you enable, reviewing questions, report review and ending conversations, security and troubleshooting. We do not sell personal information or use conversations for targeted advertising. The service has no advertising. To improve it, usage is counted only as daily totals that identify no one: how many devices reach each step of getting started, and how many users come back a given number of days after joining. Each device remembers only which steps it has already sent. On the web, Cloudflare Web Analytics counts page visits and referrers without cookies.

sharing.title: 4. Conversations and reports
sharing.body: Messages are shared with your room partner. Reporting or removing a partner ends their membership, invalidates existing invites and deletes the conversation for both people. The person initiating removal keeps the Buddy and album. Report evidence is kept separately for operator review and is not shared with the reported person or other users. Submission content may be sent to the operator by email. Information may be disclosed to relevant authorities where legally required and only to the necessary extent.

providers.title: 5. Service providers and international processing
providers.body: Google Firebase Authentication provides sign-in and processes authentication data in the United States. MongoDB Atlas and Amazon Web Services (Lightsail) store chat/service data and operate the server; the current service region is Sydney, Australia. Cloudflare delivers the website, network security and cookie-free web visit statistics, and may process technical information across its global network. Notifications pass through Expo, Apple or your browser push provider. App inquiry and report notifications go directly to the operator's Google Gmail inbox through the Gmail API. Email sent to the public contact address passes through Cloudflare Email Routing. Email content may be processed on these providers' global infrastructure. These providers process information to supply their services, including necessary international network transfers during use. Contact us with questions or requests about international processing.

retention.title: 6. Retention and deletion
retention.body: Account and service data are retained while you use the service. Delete your account in Settings. If your partner remains after ordinary room departure, their room, Buddy and shared conversation remain. Account deletion removes messages you sent and system records containing your name, including in rooms you previously left, and removes your actor information from care events. Your partner’s messages, room, Buddy and album remain. When the last member leaves, the room and conversation are deleted. Reporting/removal deletes the conversation for both people, while report evidence is retained separately. Server records for questions, reports and removals become eligible for automatic deletion 90 days after submission and are removed by the database cleanup cycle. Operator email copies are manually deleted when no longer needed after handling. Unlinked guest accounts are cleaned up by Firebase after 30 days from creation; expired guest service data is cleaned up periodically. Database backups and server disk snapshots for recovery are kept for up to 30 days and then deleted automatically; until then, deleted data may remain in a backup. Photo files are included only in server disk snapshots, so a deleted photo may remain in a snapshot for up to 7 days before it is removed automatically. Technical security/error information follows the relevant infrastructure provider retention policies.

security.title: 7. Safeguards
security.body: We use HTTPS/WSS and verify authentication and current room membership. Report evidence is not exposed through public APIs and is available only to people with operational access. Chat is not end-to-end encrypted: the server processes conversation content as needed to provide the service and handle reports.

rights.title: 8. Your choices and rights
rights.body: Change your display name, turn off device notifications, leave a room or delete your account in Settings. Send access, correction, deletion or processing restriction requests to {{email}}. We verify identity and consider other users’ rights before responding under applicable law. Questions and reports do not require a reply email.

children.title: 9. Children
children.body: This service is not directed to children under 13. Contact us if you believe information from such a child has been collected; we will verify and take appropriate action, including deletion.

changes.title: 10. Changes
changes.body: We update this page and its effective date when the policy changes. Significant changes to purposes or sharing are announced in the app or service website, with separate consent where required.

topLevelLetter.title: Thank you for coming all the way
topLevelLetter.body:
Hi, I'm the one who made puny-chat.

Thank you so much for getting here. The top level isn't somewhere you reach in a day or two, so if you're reading this, you two must have been talking every day for quite a while.

Guests at the window, books filling the shelf one by one, a kotatsu in winter: this room was built from your conversations. You now have every one of the things I made for it.

From now on you can change the job any time. You can keep living together just like this, or, when you're ready, let your buddy go its own way and start again with a new egg. Buddies who move out stay in the memory album.

If there's anything you'd like, or anything that bothers you, tell me any time through "Help & reports" in settings. I read every one.

I hope today is full of good talks.

roomUpdate.title: The room changes every level
roomUpdate.body:
Every time your buddy levels up, something new comes to the room: guests at the window, a music box and a radio on the wall shelf, plush friends on the sill, a goldfish on the side table, a low table that turns into a kotatsu in winter. 50 in all.

Some only come out in their season, like cherry petals, a wind chime, red dragonflies and kagami mochi. You can see when in the level rewards of the guide.

The top level is now 60, and the buddies who went their own way are in the memory album on the stage.

linkAccount.title: To keep chatting on another phone or browser
linkAccount.body:
You're using puny-chat as a guest. A guest lives only in this app (or browser): opened on another phone, in another browser or from the home screen, it starts over. After 30 days it's gone.

Link an account in Settings and your buddy and chats stay with the account, wherever you open them.

guestDays7.title: 7 days left as a guest
guestDays7.body:
In 7 days the guest account goes away, and your buddy and chats with it.

Link an account in Settings to keep everything as it is.

guestDays1.body:

Link an account in Settings now to keep everything as it is.

pushOff.title: Turn on message notifications
pushOff.body: On the web, notifications have to be turned on by you. With them on, you hear right away when your friend sends a message.

pushInstall.title: Getting notifications on iPhone
pushInstall.body:
An iPhone sends notifications only to apps added to the home screen. Tap Safari's Share button → 'Add to Home Screen', then open puny-chat from the home screen.

The home-screen app keeps its own data, apart from Safari. If you're a guest, link an account first so the home-screen app opens the same buddy and chats.
